title: DC Presales - Pune
description:
Job Description:

**Job Title:**
**Sr.Solution Architect – Core DC**

**Job Location: Pune**

Day Shift & 5 days a week

**Experience:**
4+ years above

**Relevant Experience: 4 years**

**Designing Experience:**
Core Data Center technologies, including servers, storage, virtualization, and VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure) & Backups.

**Job Description:**

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic Presales Core Data Center Specialist to join our team. This role is pivotal in supporting our sales efforts by providing expert technical guidance and designing innovative solutions tailored to meet our clients' data centre needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in working with Core Data Center technologies, including servers, storage, virtualization, and VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure). They should be adept at engaging with customers, understanding their requirements, and crafting compelling technical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions aligned with their business goals.
* Design and configure comprehensive solutions utilizing HP, IBM, Dell servers, EMC, NetApp, and other storage solutions, along with VMware and Citrix virtualization technologies.
* Act as the primary technical contact for customers, demonstrating deep expertise in Core Data Center technologies during presentations, workshops, and discussions.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, from initial discovery through solution design and proposal development.
* Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concept implementations to showcase the feasibility and benefits of proposed solutions.
* Continuously stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive landscape related to Core Data Center solutions.
* Collaborate with product management and engineering teams to provide feedback on customer requirements and contribute to product roadmap discussions.
* Prepare and deliver high-quality technical documentation, including proposals, architecture diagrams, and technical specifications.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience (X years) in a presales or technical consulting role focused on Core Data Center technologies.
* Expertise in designing and implementing solutions involving servers (HP/IBM/Dell), storage (EMC/NetApp), virtualization (VMware/Citrix), and VDI.
* Strong understanding of data center architectures, including compute, storage, networking, and virtualization technologies.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in customer-facing roles, with a track record of building strong relationships and delivering technical presentations.
* Certifications such as VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Citrix Certified Associate (CCA), or similar, would be advantageous.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Advanced certifications in relevant technologies (e.g., VMware Certified Advanced Professional, Citrix Certified Professional).

Experience with additional technologies such as Cisco UCS, Microsoft Hyper-V.

Prior experience in a similar role within the IT services or solutions provider industry.

**Location and Travel Requirements:**
This position may require travel to client sites for meetings, presentations, and project implementations as necessary.

**Benefits:**

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

Comprehensive health benefits package.

Professional development opportunities and support for certifications.

Collaborative and dynamic work environment with opportunities for career advancement.

title: Director Presales Solutioning
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solutioning \& RFP Response**
* Collaborate with the sales team to understand client channel and distribution requirements and develop tailored S\&D solutions, based on Comviva’s BlueMarble Retail product suite, that address their operational and commercial needs
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for large\-scale Sales \& Distribution transformation bids covering Dealer \& Channel Management, Inventory Management, Point of Sale, Field Force Automation, Stock \& Order Management, SIM Kitting, and Warehouse Management
* Assist in the preparation of proposals, bids, RFP responses and contextual Product Demos — ensuring alignment with client requirements, industry best practices, and Comviva’s business objectives
* Design multi\-channel, multi\-geography distribution transformation approaches with supporting volumetrics, phasing options, and structured trade\-off analysis.


**Domain \& Technical Depth**
* Act as a subject matter expert on Comviva’s Sales \& Distribution platform — providing credible, experience\-grounded guidance to clients and internal stakeholders across all S\&D functional domains
* Demonstrate deep understanding of Dealer \& Channel Management — including distributor hierarchies, channel partner onboarding, territory management, credit and commission management, and SLA\-driven performance frameworks
* Architect solutions for Point of Sale and Field Force Automation — covering assisted and unassisted sales flows, trade promotion execution, beat planning, retailer engagement, and real\-time stock visibility for on\-ground sales teams
* Design end\-to\-end Inventory and Warehouse Management solutions — including SIM and device kitting workflows, stock allocation, replenishment logic, returns management, and multi\-warehouse orchestration


**Presales Delivery**
* Build highly contextual compliance responses, high\-quality solution proposal documents, and bid response artefacts that accurately represent Comviva’s S\&D platform capabilities
* Prepare and conduct compelling product demonstrations and presentations — bringing Comviva’s Sales \& Distribution capabilities to life for channel operations heads, IT leadership, and CXO audiences
* Lead solution proposal defense workshops with customer evaluation committees and senior stakeholders — structuring narrative, anticipating functional and commercial challenges, and holding the room
* Build program effort models and delivery timelines aligned to contract milestones, reflecting realistic go\-live phasing across channel, geography, and functional rollout sequences
* Coach internal bid teams and client stakeholders on transformation risk — particularly around channel cutover complexity, distributor data migration, parallel operations management, and change adoption across field force


**Market \& Client Engagement**
* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to maintain a sharp understanding of the telecom Sales \& Distribution market landscape — including the evolving dynamics of digital channel management, e\-SIM distribution, and AI\-driven field force optimization
* Engage with clients to gather feedback and insights, identify opportunities for improvement, and contribute to Comviva’s S\&D product development and roadmap initiatives


**Key Skills**
**Domain \& Technical**
* 8–12 years across Sales \& Distribution solutioning, presales, solution consulting, or channel operations within a telecom product, services, or system integration company
* Deep functional knowledge of telecom S\&D domains — Dealer \& Distributor Management, Channel Hierarchy \& Territory Management, Point of Sale (assisted and digital), Field Force \& Trade Automation, Inventory \& Warehouse Management, SIM/Device Kitting, and Stock \& Order Management
* Hands\-on experience with at least one large\-scale S\&D transformation or platform implementation program — preferably covering multiple geographies or channel tiers
* Working knowledge of how S\&D platforms integrate with BSS systems — CRM, EPC/Charging, and ERP — and the ability to articulate interface design and data flow positions confidently
* Familiarity with digital channel evolution in telecom — e\-SIM provisioning, digital onboarding, self\-care for retailers, and omnichannel distribution models
* Basic but confident understanding of Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and DevOps practices — enough to engage credibly with technical evaluation teams and frame solution delivery positioning
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to translate complex distribution operations into structured solution architectures and clear business value narratives


**Communication \& Collaboration**
* Exceptional written English — able to construct solution narratives, executive summaries, and scope position papers that are precise, persuasive, and free of ambiguity
* Strong and fluent verbal presence — comfortable leading workshops, managing pushback in live defense sessions, and adapting register from a field operations deep\-dive to a boardroom briefing
* Active listener who builds credibility with channel operations and IT teams by understanding their on\-ground realities before positioning solutions
* Collaborative by instinct — works fluidly across solution, delivery and product teams without creating silos, and brings others along rather than working in isolation
* Carries a smile and is ego\-aware — intellectually confident but places collective outcome above personal position, and remains genuinely open to better thinking from anywhere in the room
* Culturally aware and able to operate effectively across diverse geographies and stakeholder personalities
* Flexibility to engage with clients across Europe and US time zones as required


**AI Fluency \& Adoption**
* Uses GenAI tools deliberately and ethically — as a thinking partner and quality accelerator — ensuring every client\-facing output reflects genuine Comviva solution understanding and personal intellectual ownership
* Exercises calculated creativity — using AI to explore, compress, and elevate ideas that are already grounded in domain knowledge, so that what reaches the client is sharper, not synthetic
* Maintains authentic projection of Comviva’s products, solutions, and culture in all AI\-assisted output
* Understands and respects the ethical boundaries of GenAI use in a client engagement context — no fabrication of capabilities, no inflation of references, no use of AI to obscure gaps that should instead be honestly addressed.
* Stays current with emerging AI capabilities relevant to the presales and S\&D domain — including AI\-driven field force optimization, predictive inventory management, and intelligent channel analytics — and proactively integrates useful tools into personal workflow, contributing to a culture of responsible AI adoption within the Comviva presales practice


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Telecom, Technology, Business, or a related field
* Experience presenting to and managing procurement\-driven evaluation processes with structured scoring
* Exposure to Tier\-1 operator S\&D programs in APAC or Middle East — markets with high prepaid penetration, large informal retail networks, and complex SIM distribution logistics


**Preferred Skills**
* Understanding of e\-SIM and eSIM\-as\-a\-service distribution models and their implications for traditional channel architecture
* Experience with trade promotion management, incentive compensation, or gamification within field force platforms

title: Proposal Engineer

**In return, we offer you**

**Pune**
**Last Day to Apply**
 07/10/2026
   

  

**Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice**

title: AI Solution & Transformation Architect (Tech Managed Service)
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GMS Senior Manager\_ AI Solution \& Transformation Architect (Tech Managed Service)**
**AI Solution \& Transformation Architect (Tech Managed Service) \- Global Managed Services**
 At EY, we’re more than just a professional services firm — we’re a global network of 400,000 professionals and one million alumni united by a shared purpose: to build a better working world. We empower our people to challenge the status quo, embrace innovation, and deliver lasting impact for our clients and communities.
   

  

 Managed Services is a significant part of the EY business, comprising more than US$7b in revenue with major clients across the globe. We provide clients with a comprehensive approach to managing non\-core functions, focusing on delivering strategic outcomes and long\-term value through expert collaboration and advanced technology. Through integrated solutions and deep sector and domain expertise, we seek to deliver enhanced value to our clients. The Managed Services team is ambitious and is working to more than double our success in the future. Join us in this role and you’ll be right at the heart of a function that impacts EY, our clients and people.
   

  

 You’ll also find a culture that prioritizes learning, collaboration, and growth — providing you with the tools, support, and freedom to thrive and shape your career.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The AI Solution \& Transformation Architect (Tech Managed Service) will design and propose AI\-first Managed Services solutions across Data Managed Service, Application Managed Services (AMS), and AI as a Service sub solutions. The role focuses on embedding agentic workflows, and automation, AI\-driven productivity, build compelling sector and tool specific deep AI led client impact narratives, transformation solution pricing and commercial business case constructs within the managed service pursuits to create scalable, outcome\-based delivery models.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end AI solutioning for large Tech Managed Service RFP/RFIs
* Define AI driven productivity commitments backed by automation roadmap
* Developing ROI and TCO\-backed AI Narrative
* Develop AI\-integrated operating models
* Reimagination of traditional TechOps operating models with Agentic possibilities
* AI\-backed value engineering \& commercial differentiation
* Design end to end AI architectures across LLMs, NLP, RAG, Agent skills, Knowledge graph, vector databases, and predictive analytics.
* Engage with Deal Architect /Team in workshops, discovery sessions, and design sessions
* Create managed service pursuit slide decks with deeply infused client context
* Perform sector specific and Tool specific AI research and publish point of view / thought leadership papers on periodic basis
* Constantly research, learn, maintain and collaborate with EY.ai Tech MS relevant assets \& tools landscape and EY global stakeholder group
* Deep collaboration with super region leaders, client partners and leadership teams
* Lead POCs, MVPs, and rapid prototyping.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI capabilities into Tech MS solution offerings
* Perform AI maturity assessments
* Design responsible AI and agentic AI guardrails as per client’s policies
* Perform Fin Ops analysis/ AI services and token cost estimates


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience and expertise in enterprise observability and AIOps landscape and solutioning (E.g. Dynatrace, Datadog, New relic, SAP Could ALM etc)
* Expertise and experience in multiple agentic AI platforms, architecture and automation tools (E.g. Azure AI foundry, GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, SAP BTP \& Business AI Platform, SNOW assist, LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, UIpath, SAP Signavio, Celonis Process Intelligence etc)
* Extremely proficient in client story telling \& presentation – verbal as well as powerpoint slides
* Data engineering proficiency (SQL, ETL pipelines, streaming, data lakes) and understanding of Data engineering agents
* Understanding of enterprise security, identity, compliance, and governance in AI deployments.
* Experience in agentic solution design, build and deployment, Deep understanding of LLMs, NLP, GenAI, RAG, Prompt engineering \& model tuning
* Experience in Technology Managed Service pre\-sales \& solutioning as Solution Architect


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 15\+ years of overall consulting, pre\-sales and managed service experience
* Engineering graduate
* Post graduation in AI \& ML
* Azure AI Engineer / AI Architect / SNOW Assist / SAP AI Architect
* ITIL Foundation (for AMS solutioning)
* SAFe Certifications
* Certified Solution Architect
* Certified Enterprise Architect
* Ideally, you’ll also have
* Experience and expertise of multiple SaaS tools and platforms (E.g. SAP, Salesforce, Servicenow, Guidewire etc)
* Pursuit solutioning experience (RFP, RFI, RFQ)
* Deep awareness of Technology Managed service competitive landscape


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader you may aspire to become.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Product Specialist
description:
We are Siemens
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 Are you seeking a role where you can contribute to the development and application of AI in engineering simulation as well as work on technology that uses existing simulation data to enable faster and more efficient predictions?
   

  

 We're hiring a Technical Specialist who will play a key role in connecting development, product management, and customer\-facing teams. This position offers the opportunity to work across a range of activities, contributing technical depth while supporting real\-world customer challenges.
   

  

 Join our growing global team working at the intersection of physics simulation and artificial intelligence. Simcenter PhysicsAI focuses on using AI to learn from existing simulation data and enable faster predictions, helping engineering teams explore and evaluate designs more efficiently.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a collaborative, evolving team working across development, product, and customer\-facing functions as well as engaging with real\-world engineering challenges and help shape future solutions then we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

 You'll make a difference by:
   

  

* Supporting customer\-facing engagements by delivering technical demonstrations and responding to in\-depth questions
* Assisting customers during software evaluations, including guiding them through benchmarks and helping optimise outcomes
* Collaborating with internal teams on technical benchmarks and validation activities
* Contributing to outbound technical communication, such as training materials, documentation, or presentations
* Capturing and communicating customer feedback to inform future product development
* Acting as a liaison between development, product, sales, and marketing teams


 Your success is grounded in:
   

  

* Experience working with physics\-based simulation, such as structural or fluid simulation tools (e.g. Nastran, OptiStruct, STAR\-CCM\+ or similar)
* Familiarity with simulation software environments, including tools within the Simcenter portfolio (or comparable platforms)
* Programming skills, with Python experience preferred
* Understanding of fundamental machine learning concepts, such as data curation, model training, and testing workflows
* Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to different audiences
* Experience working collaboratively within distributed or global teams


 This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.
   

  

 Join our Digital World
   

  

 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work\- hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

 Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ** 




 Xploreteq is a Pune\-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50\+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking a client\-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero\-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on\-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud\-native SASE/SSE.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Assessment \& Design** 




 •   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.
 



 •   Author High\-Level and Low\-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.
 



 •   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.
 



**SASE/SSE Implementation** 




 •   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.
 



 •   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.
 



 •   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart\-steering rules.
 



 •   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content\-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.
 



**Integration \& Go\-Live** 




 •   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group\-based policy.
 



 •   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).
 



 •   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post\-go\-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.
 



**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 




 •   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.
 



 •   Hands\-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.
 



 •   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.
 



 •   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.
 



**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS** 




 •   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).
 



 •   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.
 



**COMPETENCIES \& SOFT SKILLS** 




 •   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.
 



 •   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.
 



 •   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.
 



**WHAT WE VALUE** 




 At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.
 



**REPORTING** 




 Reports to the Tech Lead.
 



**TO APPLY** 




 Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:
 



 •   Current CTC
 



 •   Expected CTC
 



 •   Notice period
 



 •   Current location
 



 •   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

 For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
 At Forescout, we seek customer driven individuals who thrive on collaboration, embrace innovation, and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working as one team, we anticipate emerging threats and create forward\-thinking solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity. Join us and make a meaningful impact through your unique talents and perspective.
   

  

 The Advanced Services Engineer (ASE) position at Forescout Technologies offers the opportunity to assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem\-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real\-world customer environments. The ASE will troubleshoot the Forescout solutions, provide upgrade and deployment best practices to the base Forescout Solution, as well as integrate the Forescout product with other customer third\-party software, such as remote access and SIEM technologies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop a deep understanding of Forescout products and in\-depth knowledge of environments in which they are deployed.
* Provide complex product support, in a collaborative team environment, to customers, other Forescout employees, and partners.
* Participate in knowledge transfer with teammates, attend formal team training sessions, brown bags, and formal mentoring.
* Routinely monitor and develop knowledge assets to enable customer self\-sufficiency.
* Monitor and manage Support Services cases.
* Achieve a high level of expertise in all areas of the product.
* Capable of completing assigned duties, handling cases, and escalations within guidelines with minimal direction from Support Services Leadership.
* Routinely act independently while researching and developing solutions to customer issues.
* Liaison to Engineering on product issues, including design, features, and defects.
* Acts as a technical point of contact and is repeatedly sought by others to provide specialty knowledge to assist them in their problem\-solving.
* Administer and mature a customer enterprise deployment of the Forescout solution.
* Interface with Forescout Support and/or R\&D to resolve issues that may impede success.
* Analyse and optimize polices in accordance with customers’ business requirements.
* Manage equipment installation and configuration at all locations, to include lab environments.
* Assist customers with planning and executing Forescout software and hardware upgrades.
* Create customer reports to achieve project alignment and unity of effort.


**What You Will Bring To Forescout**
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Expertise in debugging and root\-cause analysis in complex systems and large environments
* Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and strong knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networks to include ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches.
* Experience with the configuration of Forescout products.
* Hands\-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP\+, Security\+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware \-vSphere, Microsoft Hyper\-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows\-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large\-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti\-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong customer orientation, good organizational skills, self\-driven with the ability to multi\-task on various projects, and aptitude to learn new technologies.
* Knowledge/experience utilizing Salesforce.com or similar CRM tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working in demanding and challenging environments.
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* ForeScout Certified Administrator (FSCA) and/or ForeScout Certified Engineer (FSCE) within the first year of employment.
* A self\-motivated individual with a ‘can do’ attitude.


**What Forescout Offers You**
 Managing cyber risk, together – We are led by a visionary leadership team who encourages professional growth and development. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture providing for a collaborative and innovative environment where our team can make an impact on worldwide security while working on technology which is at the forefront of the industry. We are also proud of our competitive compensation and benefits offered. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.
* Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.


**Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us.
   

  

 If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply!**
**Pre\-Employment Screening and Verification**
 At Forescout, we are “Cyber Obsessed”. As a global cybersecurity company, we are committed to maintaining a secure environment for our customers, employees, and business operations. To support these efforts, candidates may be asked to complete job\-related pre\-employment screening and verification processes, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Depending on the role and location, these measures may include identity verification, employment verification, background screening, work authorization verification, and other lawful security\-related checks. Forescout conducts these processes in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including privacy and data protection requirements, and obtains any required notices, authorizations, or consents before conducting such screenings.
   

  

**Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment**
 As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence ("AI") or automated decision\-support tools to review applications, assess job\-related qualifications, match candidates to role requirements, and coordinate interviews. These tools support, but do not replace, the judgment of qualified recruiters and hiring managers, who remain involved throughout the process. We use AI responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards.
   

  

**Note to Employment Agencies**
 We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Forescout does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.  Submissions made without a signed Employment Placement Agreement and an authorized search engagement for the specific position through our Talent Acquisition team will be considered unsolicited, and no placement fee will be paid.
   

  

 Forescout Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We value and embrace diversity, equality, inclusion, and collaboration at the core of our “One Team” philosophy. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Project Engineer - Upgrades
description:
Your role
   

  

**Mission**
 As a Project Engineer Upgrades, you will be at the forefront of developing and implementing innovative aftermarket products that enhance the efficiency and reliability of our global installed base. You will drive the product life cycle for Electrical Cubicles \& Drives (OEM), from feasibility to final implementation, ensuring that our service offerings align with the latest technology advancements and meet the needs of our customers worldwide.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Own and execute Electrical components upgrade and replacement projects from feasibility study to final implementation.
* Evaluate technical suitability of alternative electrical components such as contactors, relays, circuit breakers, power supplies, terminals, protection devices, wiring components, and related cubicle items.
* Analyse field issues, customer requests, and supplier inputs to propose technically sound and cost\-effective upgrade solutions.
* Support proactive projects related to product phase\-out, new technology introduction, supplier changes, cost optimization, and spare part availability.
* Support OEM drives\-related upgrade activities, drive retrofit instructions, BOM management, parameterization inputs, cubicle \& wire harness requirements, and other technical documentation required for global roll\-out.
* Prepare and update service diagrams, Integration of field problems and converting them into actionable instructions for global install base.
* Support electrical requirements of aftermarket products such as Energy recovery solutions, central controllers, connectivity modules, communication interfaces, and related upgrade packages.
* Ensure upgrade solutions are safe, service\-friendly, compatible with existing machine designs, and practical for field installation.
* Support product life cycle management by ensuring continued availability of critical electrical components during the service life of installed machines.
* Work closely with purchasing, suppliers, technical support, product companies, marketing, and global customer centers to align alternative solutions with business and service needs.
* Contribute to standardization, simplification, and continuous improvement of electrical upgrade processes, documentation, and component selection guidelines.


 To succeed, you will need
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or relevant stream of engineering.


**Knowledge And Experience Requirements**
* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant engineering experience in electrical design, aftermarket engineering, component selection, product development, or upgrade projects.
* Strong understanding of electrical cubicle components, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, component datasheets, and basic panel/cubicle design principles.
* Clear understanding of product life cycle management, especially how component availability, technology changes, vendor changes, and end\-of\-life decisions affect the installed base.
* Experience in identifying, comparing, validating, and releasing alternative electrical components for legacy machines or service applications.
* Experience with frequency drives, OEM drives, or drive\-related upgrade projects.
* Ability to read and understand electrical documentation, supplier specifications, product standards, and service requirements.
* Hands on experience on Auto\-Cad, Inventor, PLM would consider a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of compressor products, electrical systems, and aftermarket service requirements would be an added advantage.
* Good English communication skills, both written and spoken, with the ability to work in a global matrix organization


 Personality Requirements
   

  

* Structured and critical mindset to understand the impact of projects/offered solutions.
* Problem solver with a strong focus on safe, reliable, and service\-friendly solutions
* High ownership approach with the ability to bring innovative ideas and solutions
* Enjoy working in a team and values collaboration with diverse internal and external stakeholders across organizations and cultures.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work with mechanical components to gain a holistic understanding of the products.
* Detail\-oriented working style, balanced with the ability to see the bigger picture


 In return, we offer
   

  

* A work culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behaviour and integrity.
* Access to Global Job Opportunities as a part of Atlas Copco Group
* Opportunities to grow and develop in connected world
* Potential to see your ideas realized and to make an impact
* New challenges and new learnings with global matrix organization


 Job location
   

  

 Hybrid
   

  

 This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at our Pune office.
   

  

**Uniting curious minds**
 Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Manager SAP SAC Planning / EPM Consultant to lead end‑to‑end planning implementations and drive finance transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, client‑facing EPM engagements, leveraging SAP SAC, BPC, and emerging AI capabilities such as SAP Joule.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**SAP SAC Planning – Implementation \& Delivery**
* A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design and build SAC Planning Models and Dimensions, including public and private dimensions with attributes and hierarchies.
* Develop Data Actions, Multi\-Actions, and Allocation processes to support driver\-based planning and automation.

title: EYP-IA-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Associate/ Assistant Manager – Infrastructure Advisory**
 As part of EY's Infrastructure Advisory (IA) team within Strategy and Transactions (SaT), we support both public and private sector clients across a wide range of infrastructure initiatives. The IA team delivers advisory services throughout the infrastructure value chain, partnering with EY's onshore Infrastructure Advisory practices across ASEAN, Japan, Oceania, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Ireland (UKI), Western Europe and Maghreb (WEM), and China.
   

  

 Our multidisciplinary team brings expertise across several core service areas, including financial modeling and feasibility studies, data analytics and business intelligence (Power BI, Python, and Power Query), Transaction Advisory Services, Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) research, business case development and cost\-benefit analysis, as well as market and industry research.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking Associates and Assistant Managers with expertise in Financial Modelling and Analytics to join EY's Infrastructure Advisory (IA) team, with a focus on the Power, Oil, and Gas sectors. Our team helps clients create long\-term social and economic value by enabling informed decision\-making around capital investments, transactions, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 In this role, you will support clients in developing, reviewing, and enhancing complex financial models for infrastructure projects, transaction support, and corporate strategy engagements. Leveraging both traditional modelling techniques and advanced technologies such as Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Agentic AI and Python, you will help deliver data\-driven insights that address client needs and support critical business decisions.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a leading global organization and accelerate your career through diverse engagements, continuous learning, and mentorship opportunities. As a member of the Modelling and Analytics team, you will apply sophisticated financial and data analytics techniques to solve complex business challenges, improve decision\-making, and help clients make faster, more informed choices in a rapidly evolving
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and support engagement teams in delivering Financial Modelling, Analytics, and Strategic Advisory services, enabling clients to make informed decisions related to investments, transactions, financing, operations, and long\-term growth strategies.
* Develop, review, and enhance complex financial models, with a particular focus on the Power, Oil \& Gas, transportation, and broader infrastructure sectors.
* Advise clients on transaction support engagements, including mergers and acquisitions, project financing, debt and corporate restructuring, valuations, and strategic planning initiatives.
* Support the development and assessment of Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) arrangements, project structuring, commercial evaluations, and procurement strategies.
* Conduct financial feasibility studies, business case development, economic impact assessments, and cost\-benefit analyses to evaluate project viability and support investment decisions.
* Apply advanced data analytics, automation, and visualization tools, including Power BI, Power Query, Python, VBA, and Excel, to transform complex data into actionable insights and decision\-support frameworks.
* Perform independent reviews and validation of financial models, identify key risks and assumptions, conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses, and present findings to clients in a clear and concise manner.
* Drive research and development initiatives, including market intelligence, industry benchmarking, policy and regulatory analysis, emerging technology assessments, and the development of innovative analytical tools, methodologies, and best practices.
* Contribute to thought leadership and knowledge development through research publications, sector insights, white papers, and the creation of reusable frameworks that enhance EY's Infrastructure Advisory capabilities globally.
* Collaborate with EY's global Infrastructure Advisory teams to deliver high\-quality services across project finance, infrastructure transactions, corporate finance, sustainability, and strategic advisory assignments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong academic background preferably with a professional qualification in finance/ MBA/ accounting/ CFA/ FRM and solid understanding of corporate finance
* Experience in one or more infrastructure sectors \- power \& utilities, Oil and Gas including renewables, transport, and social infrastructure, etc.
* Strong quantitative skills with the ability to understand financial statements and build three statement financial models in Excel. Exposure to VBA will be preferred.
* Experience with building dynamic dashboards or automated corporate strategy solutions using Databricks, Python, or Agentic AI
* Knowledge of PPP/ PFI modelling is preferred
* Exceptional economic and financial modelling skills with a demonstrated aptitude in quantitative and qualitative study
* Knowledge of Alteryx and Visualization tools (preferred)
* Exceptional analytical, problem solving and presentation/ report writing skills, combined with a good understanding of business dynamics and commercial value drivers
* Exhibit thoughtfulness and problem\-solving skills
* Good project and time management skills with the ability to multi\-task
* Ability to coach and mentor team members on writing, technical skills and soft skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Postgraduate in the areas of environment, sustainability, energy or related field Management/ MBA/ CFA/ FRM from a reputed college/ University. Professional qualification in Finance / Power / Infrastructure Management will be preferred.
* Relevant experience of 7\-8 years for Associate Manager and 6\-7 years for Assistant Manager


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
 Experience of working in professional services industry which will give an edge
   

  

**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-prominent, multi\-disciplinary team of 1500 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Role Description** 








 At Zoetis, our Core Beliefs form the foundation of our culture. Our Core Behaviors describe a common set of actions that demonstrate these Core Beliefs. Our Core Behaviors include:
 


* Our Colleagues Make the Difference
* Always Do the Right Thing
* Customer Obsessed
* Run It Like You Own It
* We Are One Zoetis



 This is a sales role with primary responsibility being to manage a territory and generate sales from assigned set of customers. Additionally, the candidate is expected to learn and utilize solution selling, territory management, and business planning capabilities to establish relationships and maximize sales performance within the assigned territory.
 







**Primary Responsibilities:** 




**Sales Performance** 



* Meet overall sales objectives (quota) both overall and for key growth products through demand generation within targeted geography.
* Successfully launch new product and service offerings.
* Demonstrate success in other key sales metrics such as call average, coverage, time on field and product growth rate objectives



**Solution Selling Skills, Technical Knowledge, and Customer Value Delivery** 



* Demonstrate the ability to learn and execute Solution Selling capabilities.
* Build and demonstrate technical knowledge, verbal fluency, and understand veterinary practice.
* Establish relationships with and service all targeted hospitals / personnel to maintain and grow relevance and access within each account.
* Interact with customers following all Zoetis promotional guidelines.



**Territory Management and Teamwork** 



* Effectively execute a call\-cycle at the account and veterinarian level that delivers our reach / frequency expectations.
* Develop and execute a Territory Business Plan / Resource Allocation per our expectations \- effectively implementing the full complement of Zoetis resources and following up to maximize ROI.
* Responsible for distribution of Zoetis products to customers by managing distributors. Accountable for accounts receivables from distributors.







**Professional Development** 



* Successfully complete Individual Development Plan
* Exhibit willingness to accept and incorporate feedback







**Education \& Experience** 



* Graduate in Science, Pharmacy, Lifesciences
* Animal Health or other industry related experience preferred
* Follow\-through and attention to detail
* Professional demeanor and presentation style
* Focused and results oriented, able to identify goals and priorities and resolve issues in initial stages
* Willingness to work independently and in a close team environment, self\-starter
* Exhibit willingness to accept and incorporate feedback







**Technical Skills Requirements** 



* Verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
* Ability to exercise good judgment and make thoughtful / fair decisions based on relevant information
* Computer skills (MS Office, Outlook, and ability to learn Zoetis systems)







**Physical Position Requirements** 




 Ability and willingness to travel to out stations and ex\-stations to meet customers based on customer visit cycle.
 







**Location: Pune** 
  








  


***About Zoetis***
*At* 
*Zoetis* 
*, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award\-winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well\-being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.* 



  





  


***Notice:** 
 Zoetis Recruiters will contact candidates via email from an address ending in
 **@zoetis.com** 
 and may also initially connect with candidates through
 **LinkedIn** 
 , including LinkedIn InMail. Zoetis does not use Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or other web\-based/generic email domains to communicate about job opportunities, interviews, or offers of employment. If you receive a recruitment\-related email message claiming to be from Zoetis that does not come from
 **@zoetis.com** 
 , please treat it as suspicious. For your security, do not reply, click links, open attachments, share personal or financial information, or send money in response to unexpected or questionable recruitment communications.*

title: Product Specialist - Simulation Data & AI Engineering
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient
 **Product Specialist** 
 to join our Engineering Enterprise Applications \- Engineering AI Team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our customers, product management, and development teams. You will leverage your deep expertise in Computer\-Aided Engineering (CAE), design verification, and Artificial Intelligence to translate complex engineering challenges into scalable, actionable software features.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities:
   

  

* Requirements Translation: Collaborate closely with Product Management and R\&D/Development teams to translate complex customer requirements and workflows into detailed, actionable feature plans and technical specifications.
* Product \& Release Lifecycle: Drive feature planning, tracking, and execution throughout the product and release management lifecycle, ensuring alignment with enterprise engineering standards.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as the technical liaison between end\-users, support, product managers, and software developers to ensure seamless delivery of enterprise\-grade engineering tools.
* Workflow Optimization: Design, validate, and optimize CAE and engineering AI methods to enhance design verification and validation processes.
* Technical Enablement: Provide expert guidance on the integration of AI\-driven engineering applications within High\-Performance Computing (HPC) environments.


**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
 4\. Soft Skills
   

  

* Experience
* 4 to 6\+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE (Computer\-Aided Engineering), Design Verification, and Engineering AI.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience utilizing CAE and Engineering AI tools specifically for design validation and verification.
* Technical Expertise
* Domain Knowledge: Deep, expert\-level understanding of Engineering AI methods, numerical simulation, and validation methodologies.
* High\-Performance Computing (HPC): Working knowledge of HPC architectures and workload management systems; PBS Professional (Portable Batch System) is strongly preferred.
* Programming Skills: Strong programming and scripting background, with Python as the preferred language for automation, data analysis, and tool integration.
* Preferred Skills
* Prior exposure to formal Product and Release Management methodologies (Agile/Scrum).
* Familiarity with enterprise\-scale deployment of engineering software applications.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical mindset with a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve intricate technical workflows.


**Why us?**
 Working at Siemens Software means flexibility \- Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
   

  

**Siemens Software.** 
***Transform the Everyday with Us***
 \#SWSaaS

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 India
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **Partner Success Manager** 
 is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre\-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Develop and manage role\-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.


**Education Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go\-to\-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi\-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co\-sell models.


**\#Intermediate, \#Senior**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-Data Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy , end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.** 
**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies. As a Technology Strategy Consultant with expertise in Data Strategy, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic direction, understand business goals, and define how data can be leveraged to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and business growth for client organizations.
* Work closely with clients to solve strategic issues pertaining to Data, governance, architecture, and oversee the successful implementation, ensuring they align with the broader technology and business strategies.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Data Strategy)**
* Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience on either one or more of the following areas of Data Strategy:
* Enterprise Data Management – Strong understanding of data management process across the data lifecycle (MDM, ingestion, storage, transformation) with experience in evaluating the client's data landscape and architecture to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Data Ambition \& Value Realization – Having a long track record of delivering data / analytics / AI related change at an enterprise level in a particular industry or sector and helping shape a value creation story specific to the client competing in a particular market.
* Data Platform \& Architecture Design – Knowledge of data and AI platforms and architecture frameworks
* Data Operating Model Design – Having a strong understanding of data and AI capabilities, and the ability to design operating model clearly defining roles, responsibilities, and RACI for the data organization.
* Data Governance Strategy – Assessing current data and AI governance practices and maturity within client organizations, having the ability to define and implement data governance strategies and frameworks for organizations.
* Strong understanding of data, analytics, and AI technology stack and infrastructure with exposure to new age technologies such as Generative AI.
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology and data implications within one or more industries.
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging data and analytics
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing data strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes.
* Experience of being a data Product Owner and responsible for delivering product model and communicating the product needs with business partners.
* Exposure to working with non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad
* 4\-5 years of relevant experience required (post MBA / MS / MTech)
* 2\-3 years with single industry focus (preferred)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**

 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide.  As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM PM, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and configuring SAP S/4HANA\-based Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and Plant Maintenance (PM) solutions for clients. Your expertise in SAP S/4HANA EAM will enable you to help clients optimize their plant maintenance operations, improve equipment reliability, and reduce downtime.
