* Configure SAP S/4HANA EAM: Configure SAP S/4HANA EAM applications to meet clients' specific requirements, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
* Deliver Solution Expertise: Apply your expertise in SAP S/4HANA EAM to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet clients' needs and expectations.
* Support Client Operations: Help clients improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime by providing expert guidance on SAP S/4HANA EAM best practices and solution implementation.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA EAM: Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA EAM applications, including configuration and implementation, to design and deliver solutions that meet clients' business requirements.
* Experience working with Enterprise Asset Management: Understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) concepts and principles, including plant maintenance operations, equipment reliability, and downtime reduction.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Configuration: Exposure to configuring SAP S/4HANA EAM applications to meet specific client requirements, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
* Understanding of Solution Delivery: Familiarity with delivering high\-quality solutions that meet clients' needs and expectations, utilizing expertise in SAP S/4HANA EAM.
* Experience with Client Collaboration: Exposure to working closely with clients to understand their business needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and design tailored solutions to address their challenges.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* SAP S/4HANA EAM Configuration: Exposure to advanced configuration options for SAP S/4HANA EAM applications, enabling seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
* Enterprise Asset Management Principles: Understanding of EAM concepts and principles beyond plant maintenance operations, including asset lifecycle management and supply chain integration.
* Industry\-Specific EAM Solutions: Familiarity with EAM solutions tailored to specific industries, such as manufacturing, oil and gas, or utilities, to address unique business challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**
 Application Engineering in alternator. Develops strong working relationships with customer technical counterparts to serve as their primary liaison to deliver specialized product technical information, manage product specifications, communicate product change information, conduct complex installation issue resolutions and facilitate customer requests Applies technical expertise in the areas of product, application and market knowledge to support OEM product selection and equipment design Leads the translation of customer needs and "voice of the customer" into functional product requirements to provide input on program\-related decisions Serves as customer/market advocate inside Cummins during participation in new product development programs, design reviews and product change request processes Ensures products are applied and installed correctly to meet customer system requirements and environments Assures installation quality by validating prototype machine performance and ensuring installations meet Cummins requirements Utilizes Analysis Led Design (ALD) and Six Sigma tools to optimize product and system performance Proposes innovative customer\-focused initiatives and projects Assists with the transfer of knowledge through coaching and mentoring less experienced engineers Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. title: Presales Team Lead
description:
**Job Description\- Pre\-sales Lead** 




  





**Overview:** 
 Sellability is on an aggressive, market\-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed\-use projects. We're a merit\-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard\-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years.
 



  





 At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast\-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India. Our projects demand year\-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr\+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation.
 



  





**About the role:** 




 Every sale starts in pre\-sales. As Team Lead, you'll run the team that turns enquiries into site visits. That means making sure every lead is called quickly, qualified properly and handed to the closing team ready to convert. You set the pace, coach the callers and own the numbers at the top of the funnel.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  




* **Team performance:** 
 Lead and coach a team of pre\-sales executives against daily and weekly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and site visits.
* **Lead management:** 
 Make sure every lead, whether from digital, channel partners, events or walk\-ins, is contacted within the agreed response time and followed up until it closes out, with the CRM kept accurate.
* **Funnel conversion:** 
 Track the funnel from lead to connect, qualified lead, visit scheduled and visit done. Spot where leads drop off and fix it.
* **Quality:** 
 Build and refresh pitch scripts and objection handling for each project. Run regular call audits and give feedback.
* **Working with sales:** 
 Coordinate with closing managers and site heads on visit scheduling, and feed their visit outcomes back into how the team qualifies leads.
* **Working with marketing:** 
 Share lead\-quality insights by source and campaign so spend goes where leads actually convert.
* **Reporting:** 
 Send daily and weekly reports on team performance and funnel health to the cluster head.
* **Building the team:** 
 Hire, onboard and train new pre\-sales team members.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* 4–6 years in real estate pre\-sales or tele\-sales, including at least 1–2 years leading a team.
* A strong grip on funnel metrics, and comfort working in a CRM and Excel every day.
* A coach's mindset: you make callers better, not just busier.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi.
* Knowledge of Pune's residential market is a strong plus.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.



  





**Location:** 
 Baner, Pune
 



**Note:** 
 Its a 6\-day WFO role
 



  





**Why Sellability** 




  




* **Growth without limits** 
 — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr\+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large\-scale launches.
* **Performance with rewards** 
 — A merit\-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
* **Collaborative culture** 
 — Work directly with founder\-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
* **Purpose \& impact** 
 — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

title: Oracle Tech Architecture and Middleware-Zuora Billing-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Advisory – Zuora –Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Zuora Billing to join the leadership group of our consulting Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’ll focus on the design, customization and optimization of technology\-based solutions across the sales, marketing, e\-commerce, supply chain, finance, asset management and/or business and operations support systems domains. You’ll team with various EY groups with the capabilities to pursue and deliver technology engagements and solutions that will bring our clients’ vision and strategy to life.
   

  

* Solution design using the full Billing product portfolio
* Design and validate that the proposed solution architecture supports the stated and implied business requirements
* Review technical team deliverables for compliance with architecture standards, guidelines and leverages best practices
* Articulate and present different point of views on various technologies
* Present Architecture deliverables such as Ecosystem and Integration diagrams, ERD, Business Process Flows, Swim lanes, Visio and Mock\-ups
* Exhibit strong executive presence and ability to interact and effectively communicate with key project sponsors from CXO to end users.
* Deliver Expert Services to the Billing Partners


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Gather Business requirements
* Analyse requirements and Perform Fit\-Gap Analysis
* Design and Develop the requirements
* Strong expertise in configurations and testing
* Prepare and Review documentations
* Working in project teams through agreed\-upon phases of project governance, requirements definition, vendor selection, process and risk analysis, development and customization, testing, training and rollout of a client's project life cycle
* Collaborating with team members in developing applicable methodologies, tools, approaches, points of view, thought leadership and accelerators to differentiate EY
* Providing broad technical knowledge of various key technology and business platforms, teaming with client technology professionals and third\-party strategic alliances
* Developing long\-term relationships and networks both internally and externally, interacting and communicating effectively with teammates, clients, stakeholders and executives


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor's degree and 8 \- 16 years of experience relevant to this position including 5 years of consulting experience and 2 years of project management leadership experience.
* Solid Quote\-to\-Cash experience in the Billing area
* Enterprise level experience, within a professional services organization, as a Solution Architect and/or Business Consultant with a leading technology consulting or product company, delivering moderate to complex ERP, billing, revenue, procurement and/or CRM solutions (Salesforce experience is a plus)
* Demonstrated leadership abilities to lead business discussions with customers and architect the value of our solution and the best practices to implement it
* Experience in requirements gathering, use cases documentation, business analysis, systems design and integration, user interface design and implementation
* Experience in data analysis, conversion and migration, interfaces and reports
* Experience with gap analysis and blueprint development
* Experience with system design using configuration and/or customization, integration, testing and support
* Experience in delivering end to end solutions through the entire SDLC – right from running the client facing workshops, design, build, test, deployment, UAT and handover
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies
* Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a diverse and distributed team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environmen
* Experience with accounting and be able to converse effectively with Finance teams
* Experienced in technical accounting and IFRS / ASC606 is a plus
* Experience managing tasks on multiple projects simultaneously


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Degree emphasis in computer science, IT, computer engineering, MIS or mathematics desired; master’s degree in one of these areas preferred
* Consulting experience highly preferred
* Working experience with Onsite \& Offshore delivery model environment is preferred.
* Engaging with business partners and IT to understand requirements from various parts of an organization to drive the design, programming execution, and UAT for future state capabilities within the platform.
* Working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment while managing multiple projects and strict deadlines
* Good understanding of outsourcing and off shoring, building win/win strategies and contracts with suppliers


**What We Look For**
* Consulting experience, including assessments and implementations
* Experience in Zuora Billing
* Documenting requirements and processes (e.g., process flows)
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Willingness to travel 50% or more
* B.A. / B.S. degree required.
* MBA and/or professional certification (e.g. CPA, CFA) preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Application Engr II
description:
**About Honeywell**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity and global urbanization. We are a leading software\-industrial company committed to introducing state\-of\-the\-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability and safety in high\-growth businesses in broad\-based, attractive industrial end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe.
   

  

 THE BUSINESS UNIT
   

  

 Honeywell Building Automation (BA) is a leading global provider of products, software, solutions and technologies that enable building owners and occupants to ensure their facilities are safe, energy\-efficient, sustainable and productive. BA products and services include advanced software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance and upgrades of systems. Revenues in 2022 for BA were $6B and there are approximately 18,000 employees globally.
   

  

 Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Study contract documents/tenders, mechanical plans and evaluate customer requirements
   

  

 Knowledge on field device selection, BACnet and Modbus protocol
   

  

 Technical discussion and meetings with the customer
   

  

 Building Automation System engineering \& architecture design
   

  

 Application software development(BMS Application Configuration)
   

  

 Installation supervision \& BMS Commissioning at various sites across Americas, Europe, ME \& APAC poles
   

  

 BMS functional testing with the Customer \& handover
   

  

 Project Documentation
   

  

**YOU MUST HAVE**
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
   

  

 Automation /HVAC system engineering /commissioning experience
   

  

 Experience in Pharma (IQ, DQ, OQ, FAT/SAT documentation) will be an added advantage
   

  

**WE VALUE**
 Knowledge of HVAC systems, Some Engineering design /Automation /Field Engineering experience
   

  

 Flexibility to travel to various sites across globe when needed
   

  

 Effective communicator
   

  

 Individuals who are self\-motivated and able to work with little supervision
   

  

 Individuals that quickly analyze, incorporate and apply new information and concepts.
   

  

***Your role will also include overseeing, supervising, and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end\-to\-end processes and projects for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely and accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and guidance to team members on assigned tasks; and mentoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skill development, professional growth, and overall success.***
**Qualifications**
 BE/Btech only
   

  

**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Design \& Estimation incumbent serves as the primary technical authority for IBMS scope definition, system architecture design, cost estimation, and technical proposal development across mission\-critical data centre bids. The role demands deep expertise in Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS), a thorough understanding of BMS/DDC/PLC controller ecosystems, and the ability to translate complex client requirements into compelling, commercially sound technical proposals.
* Working at the intersection of Engineering, Sales, and Solution Architecture, the IBMS System Architecture Expert drives technical credibility during the bid cycle — from RFP/RFQ receipt through final bid submission and post\-bid technical clarification.


**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation \& Proposal Development** 
**C. Technical Proposals \& Bid Documentation** 
**D. Client Engagement \& Presales Support** 
**E. Internal Collaboration \& Presales Standards** 
 3\. AUTHORITIES
   

  

* KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* System Architecture \& Scope Definition
* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission\-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field\-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC\-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan\-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third\-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS\-to\-DCIM interoperability architecture for high\-density and AI data center environments.
* Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system\-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.
* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non\-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third\-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit\-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS\-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.
* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write\-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA\-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016\) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope\-of\-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre\-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre\-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre\-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post\-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no\-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons\-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.


 The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales \& Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:
   

  

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign\-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no\-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red\-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre\-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.


 4\. QUALIFICATIONS
 **4\.1 Education**
* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics \& Communication, Instrumentation, Automation \& Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre\-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi\-stakeholder reviews.


**4\.2 Experience**
* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission\-critical data center projects.
* Hands\-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC\-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution\-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA\-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016\.
* Exposure to high\-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.


**4\.3 Technical Skills Matrix**
**Skill Area** 
**Proficiency Required**
**IBMS Subsystems** 
 Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.
   

  

**Controller Platforms** 
 Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan\-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.
   

  

**BOQ \& Cost Estimation** 
 Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.
   

  

**Network \& Integration Architecture** 
 Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC\-UA), switch sizing, and third\-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).
   

  

**Technical Proposal Writing** 
 Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope\-of\-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.
   

  

**Standards \& Codes** 
 Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA\-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G\-FI\-PL\-006\).
   

  

**Thermal Management** 
 Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high\-density environments.
   

  

**Software Tools** 
 MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.
   

  

**SCADA / HMI / DCIM** 
 Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.
   

  

**4\.4 Soft Skills \& Competencies**
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi\-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self\-motivated with a quality\-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.


 5\. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
   

  

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high\-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi\-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi\-hyperscale or multi\-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability\-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.


 6\. PHYSICAL \& ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
   

  

* Primarily office\-based role with occasional site visits required for pre\-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre\-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi\-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional)
   

  

**Location:**

**Experience Required:** 
 8\+ Years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional) to lead solution design and delivery for complex Quote\-to\-Cash (QTC) transformation initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy and hands\-on technical architecture—translating SaaS subscription models, multi\-product bundles, and data workflows into scalable Salesforce CPQ configurations and integration specifications. Candidates must have personally configured Salesforce CPQ and must have practical, hands\-on experience building AI agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quote\-to\-Cash Solution Design: Map and optimize the end\-to\-end sales journey, covering account creation/validation, opportunity management, quote generation, contract finalization, and order confirmation.
* Salesforce CPQ Architecture and Configuration: Design and maintain complex bundle structures (components vs. accessories), subscription/term\-based pricing models, renewal logic, and Quote Line Editor product/validation rules.
* Account Onboarding, MDM \& Routing: Design account creation and approval workflows. Configure territory and user routing based on geography, revenue, and employee headcount.
* Integration \& Data Architecture: Partner with engineering teams to define integration specs between Salesforce CPQ, Master Data Management (Informatica MDM), middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi), and downstream invoicing engines. Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* Data \& Technical Validation: Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* AI \& Emerging Tech: Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.
* Agile Story Authoring: Write detailed user stories, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while partnering with offshore development teams to drive sprint execution.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to Salesforce CPQ (SteelBrick) implementation and business analysis.
* CPQ Expertise: Hands\-on mastery of Salesforce CPQ configurations—including complex product rules, pricing waterfalls, price rules, and subscription management.
* Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, and tools such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica MDM.
* Technical Acumen: Ability to write SOQL queries, read APEX data structures, and understand complex object relationships within Salesforce.
* Process Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash, SaaS billing models, and contract lifecycle workflows.
* Emerging AI: Exposure to or strong foundational knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce and AI agent configurations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, or subscription\-first technology companies.

title: Application Specialist SPDM
description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps \& Engineering AI product management team by offering top\-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre\-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.
   

  

 The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features \& functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry\-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.
   

  

 You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.
   

  

**Activities also include**
* Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre\-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof\-of\-Concept development and demonstration
* Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
* Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
* Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
* Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
* Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
* Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.


**Your Qualifications**
 We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self\-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high\-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.
   

  

**Specific qualifications we will be looking for :**
* Extensive expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools

Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
* Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
* Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus

 Working at Siemens Software means flexibility \- Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:

 Chain IQ is a global AI\-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide.  Manager

The role ensures all deliverables meet defined quality standards and SLAs, while providing strong analytical support and documentation for operational governance. Working closely with the Senior Manager and the AVP, the Expert drives data accuracy, supports continuous improvement, and helps align delivery with Chain IQ’s global procurement practices. As a key operational counterpart to the Senior Manager and a supporting interface to the AVP, the Expert is responsible for translating requirements into precise, data‑driven deliverables while maintaining strong documentation, audit readiness, and performance tracking. The position requires advanced proficiency in procurement processes, cost analysis, and vendor management to ensure timely, compliant, and transparent service delivery.
   

  

 Learn more about Chain IQ and the global brands we support here: https://www.chainiq.com/clients/

title: Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for a data\-driven Senior Business Analyst to bridge the gap between marketing data and strategic action. You will be responsible for transforming raw campaign metrics into actionable intelligence, optimizing the lead\-to\-revenue funnel, and ensuring a seamless interlock between Sales and Marketing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The ideal candidate must possess strong expertise in advanced analytics and strategic thinking to drive marketing ROI, customer insights, and business growth.
   

  

 This role focuses on leveraging predictive analytics, automation, and data science techniques to optimize marketing performance and influence strategic decision\-making.
   

  

**Funnel Optimization \& Campaign Performance:**
* Analyze and optimize full\-funnel performance, collaborating with sales and regional teams to improve down\-funnel conversion metrics.
* Measure campaign effectiveness across traffic, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI.
* Break down performance by channel, region, product, and customer segment to identify granular growth drivers.


**Actionable Intelligence \& Predictive Insights:**
* Transition reporting from descriptive to prescriptive by utilizing predictive modeling and automated anomaly detection.
* Establish automated alerts to notify stakeholders when performance deviates from benchmarks.
* Proactively surface risks, opportunities, and performance drivers to influence strategic growth.


**Sales \& Marketing Interlock:**
* Validate and refine attribution models to accurately measure marketing’s contribution to the pipeline.
* Define success metrics and lead lifecycle performance tracking, specifically focusing on pipeline stage conversion rates.
* Partner with Marketing Ops, Data Ops, and Sales Ops to ensure data consistency and accuracy across the lead\-to\-sales journey.


**Speed\-to\-Decision \& Enablement:**
* Reduce the time from data collection to insight through AI automation and streamlined reporting frameworks.
* Translate complex data sets into clear, concise narratives and executive\-level recommendations.
* Support annual planning, forecasting, and goal\-setting for global marketing initiatives.


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
 Experience: 3\+ years in Marketing Analytics
   

  

 Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools ( DOMO, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker). Experience with Python/R for predictive modeling is a plus.
   

  

 Marketing Tech: Deep understanding of Data sources \- SFDC, SFMC and Marketing Automation (Marketo/HubSpot) data structures. Knowledge on Analytics Platforms
   

  

 Analytical Rigor: Strong expertise in multi\-touch attribution (MTA), MMM, and incrementality testing.
   

  

 Communication: Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, and Finance) with data\-backed stories.

The role will work with customer engineering teams to understand product architectures, identify system requirements, position GF/MIPS processor and mixed\-signal capabilities, and translate customer needs into clear product and technology roadmap inputs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines embedded processor systems depth with customer credibility. They should be comfortable discussing real\-time control, embedded software, system partitioning, connectivity, safety/security, mixed\-signal integration, and application\-specific tradeoffs with both customer engineers and internal product/architecture teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop system\-level collateral including block diagrams, requirements matrices, reference architectures, customer use\-case notes, and competitive positioning material.

* Own selected vertical coverage such as automotive zonal/SDV, motor drive/robotics, industrial automation, Edge AI, networking/infrastructure, or e\-mobility.
* Provide customer feedback loops to internal teams and help convert market insights into product decisions.
* Participate in customer workshops, technical reviews, architecture deep\-dives, and executive design\-win discussions as needed.

* Strong understanding of MCU/MPU product architectures, embedded software, hardware/software partitioning, and customer product requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more of: automotive electronics, industrial automation, robotics/motor control, networking/infrastructure, e\-mobility, or Edge AI systems.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customer engineering teams and internal silicon/software/product teams.
* Experience creating technical collateral, competitive analysis, architecture recommendations, and requirements documentation.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Life Insurance (Cloud-Native Platforms) - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance, cloud\-native architecture, and regulated financial services environments. This role is responsible for defining and governing end\-to\-end technology solutions that support insurance products and operations across customer onboarding, policy administration, premium collection, servicing, and claims.
   

  

 The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across multiple agile delivery teams, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. This role combines strategic thinking, hands\-on technical architecture, stakeholder engagement, and insurance domain expertise to deliver future\-ready digital insurance platforms.
   

  

 Key focus areas include cloud\-native architecture, API\-first design, microservices, event\-driven systems, integration architecture, security\-by\-design, observability, and regulatory compliance within the insurance domain.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures for Life and Funeral Insurance initiatives, balancing business objectives, technology strategy, cost efficiency, and long\-term sustainability
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLDs), detailed solution designs, architecture decision records, integration designs, and supporting architectural documentation
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and translate strategy into implementable technology solutions
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple agile squads and delivery teams
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices, and event\-driven architectural approaches
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, availability, and security
* Lead architecture reviews, governance processes, technology assessments, and design assurance activities
* Design and govern integrations across policy administration platforms, CRM systems, payment solutions, identity services, and customer engagement channels
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, risk, compliance, and business teams as a trusted technology advisor
* Apply FinOps principles to optimise cloud investments and support platform modernisation initiatives
* Ensure architecture aligns with compliance obligations such as AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, FICA, POPIA, fraud prevention, audit requirements, and privacy\-by\-design principles
* Support agile and SAFe delivery practices by providing architectural direction and delivery readiness across releases and programmes
* Leverage AI\-assisted architecture tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, design exploration, and documentation activities


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 5–10\+ years of experience across software engineering and solution architecture
* 5\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale cloud\-native solutions
* Demonstrated experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry
* Strong expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance products, policy administration, customer journeys, premium collection, servicing, claims, and domain integrations
* Proven ability to engage with both executive stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Experience designing cloud architectures, preferably on AWS
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Microservices architecture
+ Event\-driven architecture
+ REST APIs and API management
+ Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies
+ Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases
+ OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IAM, and security architecture
+ Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, and Dynatrace
+ CI/CD practices and architecture governance
+ Agile and ideally SAFe frameworks

* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, mentoring, and decision\-making skills
* Preferred certifications:
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ TOGAF
+ SAFe for Architects or equivalent certification


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to shape the future of digital Life and Funeral Insurance platforms serving large customer populations
* Exposure to business\-critical architecture decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment
* Collaborative and supportive culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful customer impact
* Opportunity to work alongside engineering, security, risk, compliance, and business leaders
* Involvement in cloud transformation and platform modernisation programmes
* Hybrid working model with regular collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
* Opportunity to influence architecture strategy, governance, and technology adoption at scale


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced cloud\-native architecture and modernisation strategies
* Enterprise\-scale insurance platform architecture and integration design
* Financial services regulatory architecture and compliance\-by\-design practices
* FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimisation techniques
* Advanced event\-driven and API\-first architecture patterns
* Enterprise observability and resilience engineering approaches
* Architecture governance and decision\-making frameworks
* AI\-assisted architecture and design acceleration techniques
* Stakeholder influencing and strategic technology leadership skills


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

* Maintain visibility of asset performance metrics and support the branch manager in reviewing asset business performance.

title: BC SECTOR-TMT-BPI-Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**OSS Technology Consultant – Blue Planet Inventory (BPI) \- Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 In this role, as a senior consultant in GDS Consulting, you will lead the implementation of Ciena/ Blue Planet products and integration with the telecommunications operators’ Operations Support Systems (OSS). You will be responsible for ensuring that a quality, integrated software solution is delivered in a timely manner, at budget, and to our client's satisfaction.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery and Product implementation, configuration, extensions, and integrations for OSS systems involving Ciena Blue Planet’s suite of products with specific focus on Blue Planet Network Inventory (BPI).
* Actively drive \& participate in Business Analysis and requirements gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Data Migration and Support.
* You will develop system, process and data requirements of the customer.
* You will map OSS software (Network Inventory) capabilities to those needs and build consensus around the solution, proposes technical solutions to system requirements.
* You will develop applicable process and system change documentation; Develop and distribute project related documentation.
* Write and maintain Java code, create Spring beans, and develop JUnit tests.
* Develop and extend GUI components such as grids and reports using core product modules.
* Adhere to established coding and documentation standards while extending core product components.
* Write and optimize database queries and procedures, primarily for Neo4j, PostgreSQL.
* Support debugging, deployment, and environment setup using tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong technical skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.


**Frontend Development:**
* Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SVG
* Frameworks/Libraries: Angular 2\+, Node.js/npm, Gulp
* Testing: Protractor, Jasmine


**Backend Development:**
* Languages: Java 11\+, J2EE
* Frameworks/Libraries: Maven, Spring (Data, Security, MVC), SpringBoot
* Testing: JUnit


**Databases:**
* Primary: Neo4j (Graph DB), PostgreSQL \+ TimescaleDB


**Additional Skills:**
* ElasticSearch, Camunda / BPMN / OSM / Workflow, Drools, Kafka integration, RESTful APIs (using Spring MVC), Docker, Kubernetes
* Programming Concepts: Algorithms, data structures, database concepts (relational and graph)


**Domain Knowledge:**
* Telecom, OSS (Operational Support Systems), Inventory Management
* Consultant with minimum of 5\+ Years proven experience and significant knowledge in Telecom OSS Network Inventory.
* Experience in Ciena Blue Planet Inventory (BPI).
* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)
* Knowledge of and preferably certification in TMForum’s eTOM framework along with Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and Open APIs.
* Exceptional quantitative skills enabling identification of key business issues and progression of solutions.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
