title: Tech Modernization – Manager
description:
**Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – Technology Modernization**
 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future\-ready technology landscapes
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network
   

  

**Areas of Work:** 
 Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization
   

  

**Level:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
   

  

**Years of Exp:** 
 10\-15 years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growth? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choices? Do you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
   

  

 If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategies, target\-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C\-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business\-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.
   

  

 We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep\-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end\-to\-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high\-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**Modernization Strategy \& Value Agenda:** 
 Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes
 **Technology Estate \& Application Portfolio Assessment:** 
 Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non\-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio\-level priorities
 **Target Architecture \& Modernization Pathways:** 
 Shape target\-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation
 **Modernization Roadmap, Business Case \& Decision Governance:** 
 Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade\-offs and realize measurable business value
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy \& Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization\-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.
   

  

 The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.
   

  

 The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade\-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long\-term architecture fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap**
* Lead enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes
* Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business\-aligned technology modernization priorities
* Assess current\-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems
* Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools
* Shape target\-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction
* Define modernization guiding principles, decision \& prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices
* Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners
* Build multi\-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness
* Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed\-to\-market


**Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture \& Planning**
* Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential
* Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities
* Define application modernization pathways for target applications
* Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options
* Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies
* Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity
* Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API\-led integration, microservices, event\-driven architecture, cloud\-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform\-based modernization
* Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future\-ready application architecture
* Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


**Executive advisory and Growth**
* Lead CxO\-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade\-offs and enterprise transformation decisions
* Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions
* Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership\-ready points of view
* Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive\-ready solution narratives
* Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client
* Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks
* Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


**Core Skillsets \& Tools**
**Technology Modernization Advisory**
* Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed\-to\-market and technology simplification
* Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt
* Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes
* Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run\-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement
* Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product\-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness
* Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


**Application Architecture, Engineering and AI**
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data \& AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts
* Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain\-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API\-led integration, cloud\-native application design and strangler\-based modernization
* Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade\-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity
* Experience with aging application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end\-of\-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes
* Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering
* Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment
* Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real\-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI\-ready application architecture
* Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


**Consulting And Communication Skills**
* Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams
* Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities
* Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**What’s in it for you?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network
   

  

 Accenture Capability Network \| Accenture in One Word
   

  

 At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

title: Replication & Backup-Architecture & Design
description:
****Role Summary:****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Enterprise DR Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and managing Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity solutions to ensure critical business services can be recovered within agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
* Nutanix DR Architecture


 The Architect shall perform the following activities aligned to the proposed DR solution and Client’s current set up:
   

  

* Validate DR design documentation provided by third\-party implementation partner. Where needed create appropriate documentation as needed to implement and support the DR.
* Lead infrastructure recovery requirements.
* Propose recovery strategies against defined RTO and RPO objectives.
* Propose workload classification and grouping methodology
* Design disaster recovery sequencing and dependency mapping for infra and network layer. Provide guidance to the applications team wrt managing the sequencing and dependency mapping.
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER to ensure that DR failover and failback approaches suits Client’s needs
* Prepare and produce appropriate DR runbooks, operational procedures and recovery documentation. Provide guidance and support the applications team to enable them crate runbooks, operational procedures and recovery documentation
* Provide risk\-based recommendations and improvement opportunities.
* Define \& produce relevant operational artefacts (e.g. a DR Operations Playbook) that cover end\-to\-end DR operational processes. Some of these processes include, but are not limited to \- DR scenarios, DR triggers and its SOPs, Failover processes, Failback processes, frequent DR testing, end\-to\-end governance \& monitoring.
* Technical Design (Nutanix DR Set\-up)


**The Architect Shall:**
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLD) \& Low\-Level Designs (LLD) for implementations needed in Client’s environment.
* Validate High\-Level Designs (HLD) \& Low\-Level Designs (LLD) provided by third\-party implementation partner.
* Validate implementation plans submitted by third\-party implementation partner.
* Produce operational readiness deliverables for current Client environment. Validate operational readiness deliverables from THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and prepare test plans and acceptance criteria.
* Provide risk mitigation approaches.
* Produce infrastructure readiness requirements for current Client environment. Review infrastructure readiness requirements from THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER.
* Architecture Governance \& Assurance


**The Solution Architect Shall:**
* Review overall Nutanix DR solution architecture proposed by third\-party implementation partner.
* Review THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER solution’s architectural alignment with Client infrastructure, security and operational requirements. Where needed architect shall produce relevant architectures in consultation with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and current Client infra support teams.
* Ensure architectural completeness risks and dependencies.
* Design for workload protection coverage for server and VDI platforms.
* Work with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER to design architecture against business continuity and resilience objectives.
* Ensure completeness of recovery scenarios, recovery dependencies and service recovery priorities.
* Ensure architecture scalability, maintainability and operational supportability.
* Stakeholder Co\-ordination


 The Architect, for the purpose of architecture reviews, requirement gathering, design clarifications and governance activities, shall coordinate and engage with:
   

  

* Client Infrastructure Manager and Project Manager
* Client BAU Support Team from Zensar
* Client Security Team
* THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER
* Testing Governance \& Quality Assurance


**The Architect Shall:**
* Produce testing methodology along with THIRD PARTY SUPPLIER and Client teams.
* Produce DR testing scenarios and guide Client teams to produce relevant DR test cases
* Provide guidance during test execution.
* Validate test outcomes against agreed objectives.
* Provide architecture readiness recommendations.
* Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance


**The Architect Shall:**
* Review operational handover documentation created and provided by third\-party implementation partner. Where needed, architect shall produce relevant operational document covering end\-to\-end DR processes that needs to be signed off by Client stakeholders mentioned above.
* Review supports readiness.
* Ensure monitoring and operational support requirements and implemented and documented.
* Assess deployment readiness.
* Ensure the current Operation teams are provided all knowledge and artefacts to execute the DR processes.
* Provide architecture acceptance recommendations.


 Final business acceptance and production approval wherever needed shall remain the responsibility of Client.
   

  

* Deliverables


 The Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall provide the following deliverables: (Pls update this basis my comments above)
   

  

* Infrastructure Readiness Assessment for Nutanix DR.
* Architecture Gap Analysis
* DR Strategy Recommendations
* Test Readiness Review
* Operational Readiness Assessment
* Executive Steering Updates
* Architecture Sign\-Off Recommendation
* Infrastructure Delivery Governance


 To support the Nutanix DR implementation activities, involved Infrastructure DR Engineer (Nutanix / VMware / Windows) to execute infrastructure readiness, recovery planning and testing.
   

  

****QUALIFICATIONS****
* The Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall:
* 
* Provide functional guidance and technical direction to the infrastructure support Engineer throughout the engagement.
* 
* Coordinate, prioritize, track, and govern the execution of infrastructure\-related activities required to support the Nutanix DR implementation.
* 
* Review and monitor completion of infrastructure discovery, dependency assessment, and readiness activities.
* 
* Govern the preparation of Nutanix, VMware, Windows Server, and associated infrastructure prerequisites required by the third\-party implementation partner.
* 
* Review infrastructure recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, and recovery runbooks prepared by the Infrastructure DR Engineer.
* 
* Track readiness of core infrastructure services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Authentication Services, File Services, and Infrastructure Management Systems.
* 
* Govern and monitor infrastructure participation in replication, failover, failback, and recovery validation testing activities.
* 
* Facilitate issue resolution, risk escalation, and stakeholder coordination related to infrastructure DR readiness.
* 
* Review and report status, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress of infrastructure workstreams to Client project stakeholders.
* 
* For clarity, the Infrastructure DR Engineer shall remain responsible for execution of assigned engineering activities, while the Nutanix DR Solution Architect shall provide governance, oversight, coordination, and technical assurance of the infrastructure workstream.
* 
* The governance responsibility described above shall be limited to Zensar\-assigned project resources only and shall not extend to the management, supervision, or governance of Client personnel, or any other customer\-appointed third\-party personnel.


****ABOUT US****
 At Zensar, we’re
 *“experience\-led everything”* 
 . We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
 *Together, we shape experiences for better futures* 
 . Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is

 Part of the $4\.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000\+ innovators across 30\+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Product Management
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Merchant Cloud and Acceptance represent core strategic priorities for the Asia Pacific region. Our mission is to empower acquirers, merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), and payment facilitators by delivering seamless, best\-in\-class experiences across both digital and in\-person commerce. We aim to position Mastercard Merchant Cloud as the leading platform for acceptance.
   

  

 As an integral part of Mastercard’s regional growth strategy, this role will support sales initiatives across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities include conducting market research and benchmarking, contributing to go\-to\-market planning, supporting solution commercialization, and engaging in client\-related activities. The individual will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams—including Product, Operations, Delivery, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and other internal partners—to drive execution and deliver strategic outcomes.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Support the identification and assessment of potential opportunities for Merchant Cloud across APAC through data analysis and insight generation.
* Conduct customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify indicators of expansion, cross\-sell, or product adoption potential
* Analyze transaction characteristics and market data to support identification of relevant customer segments
* Develop and maintain analytical frameworks and reporting models including opportunity sizing approaches, funnel and conversion analytics, and pipeline coverage metrics for internal monitoring and decision\-support purposes.
* Build and maintain integrated analytical datasets and internal insight packs by combining data sources for internal analysis.
* Integrate diverse data inputs to generate analytical insights and structured outputs that may indicate high\-potential customers segments and support internal prioritization discussions.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to provide analytical support and validate data assumptions; does not involve participation in commercial decision\-making or execution.
* Provide data backed insights, benchmarking and analytical inputs to support value propositions by relevant team, ensuring Mastercard’s differentiation in the Merchant Cloud and Acceptance space.
* Analyse client trends and develop reports and dashboards to provide visibility and support internal decision\-making and performance monitoring.
* Partner with internal technology and core payments teams to support pipeline generation through various data sources, reporting and opportunity sizing models.


**All About You**
* Experience in payments, fintech, or e\-commerce in APAC, ideally with exposure to acquirers, PSPs, merchants, or acceptance ecosystems.
* Strong data analysis capability, including advanced Excel (mandatory) and Tableau or Power BI (preferred).
* Proven ability to work with multi\-source datasets and synthesize them into clear, practical outputs.
* Experience supporting multi\-market proposition launches, including pipeline dashboards, account\-level analysis, and business insights that inform commercial decision\-making.
* Ability to translate data into simple, compelling narratives for non\-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, self\-starter mentality, and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and the ability to create structure within a matrix organization.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.

 **AI\-tooling fluency to automate repetitive implementation work rather than doing it manually each time.**
**Note \- Relocation to Pune is required for this role, Role may involve Night shifts. We work 3 days from Office in a week.**

+ Data ingestion \& onboarding: Build and validate CSV/bulk data ingestion pipelines into ETM (asset data, business context, criticality tags, third\-party vulnerability feeds)

+ Automation of implementation work itself: Use AI agents/scripting to templatize and speed up recurring implementation tasks (data mapping, connector setup, validation checks) rather than repeating manual work per customer

+ Generating transformation logic.

+ Analysing integration errors and logs.
+ Generating configuration templates.
+ Validating implementation prerequisites.

+ Performing repetitive implementation checks.
+ Building internal agents that execute controlled implementation workflows.

+ Comfortable with CSV/structured data manipulation and data validation at scale
+ Working knowledge of at least one ticketing/ITSM platform integration (ServiceNow, Jira, Remedy)

+ Strong verbal communication — able to run technical discussions directly with customer engineering/network teams, not just write code


* Preferred Qualifications:
+ Prior exposure to Qualys VMDR/ETM, or a comparable VM platform (Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys competitors)
+ Experience with SOAR platforms or security automation
+ Familiarity with cloud platform APIs (AWS/Azure/GCP) for asset ingestion
+ Basic understanding of vulnerability management workflows (so they understand why the data matters, not just how to move it)

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
**Zycus** 
 is looking for an Senior Implementation Consultant with expertise in eProcurement implementation. The ideal candidate will have 6\-10 years of experience in end\-to\-end implementation of procurement software and a strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) or Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) solutions like SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Basware, Jaggaer, or similar platforms.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead complex, global implementations for Fortune 1000 enterprises, driving successful deployment, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in enabling AI\-driven procurement transformation, leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, and emerging technologies.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle of our procurement SaaS platform. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and intelligent procurement solutions.
 



 You will also contribute to embedding AI capabilities into procurement workflows, enhancing efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Implementation \& Delivery
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of procurement SaaS solutions for global clients.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Configure and customize the platform to align with client\-specific procurement processes.
* Drive integration with ERP and third\-party systems using APIs and middleware.
* Manage and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring high\-quality deployments.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.



  





 Client Engagement \& Enablement
 



  




* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on procurement transformation and best practices.
* Conduct training sessions, workshops, and enablement programs to drive adoption.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations.



  





 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution demos and client workshops, where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience working with AI/ML\-enabled enterprise applications or automation tools.
* Understanding of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, global environment.



  





 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

title: Event Coordinator
description:
**Event Coordinator — Corporate Events** 




**Location: Pune, India** 




**Work mode: Work from office, 5 days a week** 




**Experience: 3–6 years** 




**Openings: 2 Working hours: Aligned to UAE business hours** 




**Weekly off: Any 2 days of the week** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for Senior Event Planners who can own corporate events end to end — from the first client conversation to the final delivery. You will handle the client, sale, proposal, pricing, suppliers and execution for your events.
 



 This is not a coordination role. You will be expected to win business, protect margin, manage the client relationship and deliver what you sold. You will work with corporate clients across the UAE, while coordinating venues and suppliers remotely with local on\-ground support.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own the sale** 



* Manage inbound corporate enquiries from qualification through to closure.
* Understand the client's brief, budget and objectives.
* Build compelling proposals and commercially sound quotations.
* Negotiate, handle objections and close business.
* Follow up consistently and maintain a healthy pipeline.
* Identify opportunities for upsell, repeat business and account growth.
* Own the revenue and margin of your events, not just the booking.



  





**2\. Plan the event end to end** 



* Translate client briefs into practical event plans covering venue, layout, F\&B, décor, AV,
* entertainment, staffing and logistics.
* Evaluate venue capacity, floor plans, setup constraints and operational feasibility.
* Build timelines, identify dependencies and anticipate delivery risks.
* Ensure the solution sold to the client can actually be executed.



  





**3\. Manage suppliers and commercials** 



* Source and shortlist appropriate suppliers.
* Negotiate rates and commercial terms.
* Brief suppliers clearly and lock scope in writing.
* Manage confirmations, setup requirements and delivery timelines.
* Track supplier performance and feed learnings back into Hafla's system.



  





**4\. Own event delivery** 



* Coordinate the event from confirmed booking through execution and closure.
* Manage client communication, supplier coordination and last\-minute changes.
* Resolve delivery issues quickly and protect the client experience.
* Complete post\-event closure, feedback and invoicing inputs.



  





**5\. Own your numbers** 




 Track and actively manage your own:
 


* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Conversion
* Average order value
* Response time
* Delivery quality
* Client satisfaction
* Repeat business



 You should know where you stand and what needs to improve without waiting for someone else to tell you.
 



  





**6\. Work with AI and Product** 



* Use Hafla's AI tools daily for lead management, proposals, procurement and pricing.
* Give structured feedback where AI recommendations or workflows fall short.
* Identify repetitive work that can be automated or improved.
* Help Product understand real planner and client pain points



  





**Must Have** 



* **3–6 years** 
 of experience in corporate events, MICE, banquet sales, hotel events, event



 production or an events agency
 


* Experience personally owning both the sale and delivery of events
* Strong understanding of event commercials, pricing and margin
* Strong venue and event\-planning knowledge
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Comfortable dealing directly with corporate clients
* Strong negotiation, follow\-up and client\-management skills
* Strong attention to detail and execution discipline
* Comfortable using CRM, event\-planning and other digital tools
* Ability to work independently and solve problems without constant escalation



  





**Good to Have** 



* UAE / GCC / international client exposure
* Hotel banquet, or venue\-sales experience
* Experience across décor, AV, F\&B, entertainment or production
* Existing supplier / venue relationships
* Degree or diploma in hotel management or event management
* Meaningful experience using AI tools in day\-to\-day work
* Experience working with automation, Product or technology teams
* Have Events, Travel, Hospitality, or similar industry background



  





**UAE market experience is useful, but not essential. We care more about strong event** 




**fundamentals and how quickly you learn**

 We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented Manager – Event Sponsorships \& Corporate Alliances to drive sponsorship revenue, build strategic corporate partnerships, and develop long\-term alliances for MultiFit’s events and fitness initiatives.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong B2B sales, sponsorship acquisition, corporate networking, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with a proven ability to convert prospects into meaningful partnerships.

 1\. Sponsorship Acquisition

 Develop and execute sponsorship strategies to achieve revenue targets.

 Manage the complete sponsorship sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to negotiation and closure.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (APJ Shift)
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Technical Account Management (TAM) team provides a proactive and personalized support experience for customers that require a higher level of engagement. TAMs will act as the Support primary point of contact for the customer and also be their advocate within Support and other Workday internal teams.
   

  

 The TAM ensures business objectives and goals alignment within teams. They proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability and maintain availability of the Workday system, helping customers effectively manage their operations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Workday Support is looking for a dedicated, ambitious and self\-driven Technical Account Manager with a passion for customer relations. This role requires a self\-motivated professional with technical acumen that consistently brings a high level of commitment to customers and Workday teammates. The ideal candidate brings strong communication and project management skills as well as strong technical background and the ability to strategically and tactically navigate the challenges with large and complex customers.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager will develop and maintain close relationships with a strategic group of implementing and production customers. The ideal candidate will coordinate and prioritize business critical cases/events and will be responsible for driving escalations and incidents for these customers, managing internal and external communications with stakeholders, including but not limited to C\-level executives.
   

  

**You will:**
* Work with Workday's largest strategic accounts to build positive relationships
* Prioritise multiple accounts simultaneously
* Act as a liaison between Operations, Professional Services, Development, Product Management and Customers to ensure understanding and alignment
* Become an authority in Workday's Architecture and leverage it on all engagements as needed
* Demonstrate proficiency in Workday products: HCM, Payroll, Financials
* Review upcoming customer events and planned production activities to identify potential problems, then plan and execute solutions
* Successfully engage with Senior Leadership, Technical and Functional staff to remove roadblocks, address delays and mitigate issues
* Own and drive escalated issues blocking production success
* Effectively use sound business judgment, risk avoidance and SME resources to coordinate team efforts to solve problems
* Carry out regular review of customer cases to identify trends
* Champion and advocate for customers with internal and external stakeholders
* Manage meaningful situations in a fast paced environment
* Chair roundtables to ensure close communication and relationship building with key stakeholders
* Serve on and actively participate in customer steering committee meetings
* Drive customer self\-sufficiency by ensuring their customers understand how to engage with the Workday Support organization and leverage tools
* Pilot new programs and drive continuous improvement initiatives for production customers
* Travel occasionally up to 25% of the time
* Participate in our 24x7 program


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**
* BS or MS in a Technical Degree (ie. Computer Science, MIS) or equivalent technical work experience and acumen
* 7\+ years of experience in product support, customer success, account management or consulting for large, complex ERP, HCM, Financial, CRM or cloud computing system (SaaS preferred)
* 5\+ years of experience successfully implementing or managing Workday, Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, Ultimate Software, Kronos or similar projects at a senior or executive level


**Other Qualifications**
* Working experience with at least one of the following business areas: Human Resources, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Financials
* Established history of successfully managing issues through resolution and escalation management at both the business owners and executive levels
* Demonstrated leadership skills and experience with high\-level stakeholders. Ability to engage at C\-Level
* An outstanding customer service record
* Team player with ability to engage across corporate functions (Managing Partners, Customer Support, Professional Services, Development and Product Management)
* Excellent verbal, presentation and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host webinars
* Ability to read, anticipate and assess high stress situations quickly
* Ability to deal with the stress related to project timeframes and competing priorities.
* Strong planning and organizational skills (project management experience is a must)
* Excellent analytical, problem solving, and multitasking skills
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and maintain a positive attitude


 This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates must be willing to relocate to Pune.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to work
 **APJ shift** 
 hours to support our APJ Customers.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to participate in our 24x7 program.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
   

  

 Candidates need to be able to travel weekly for customer onsite visits and events up to 50% of the time.
   

  

 Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree.  Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law.  If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

title: Product Line Manager - Greases, Maintenance and Power transmission Products
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Position Title:** 
 Product Line Manager, Industrial ISEAM (ISEAM, South\- East Asia \& Middle East)
   

  





**Reports To:** 
 Head Product Line \- ISEAM
   

  





**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune / Bangalore / Gurgaon
   

  





****Job Responsibilities****




**Job Summary**




 The Product Line, ISEAM organization plays a decisive role in defining the right offers by translating market trends, customer needs and business opportunities into competitive products and solutions. It is responsible for strengthening the competitiveness, profitability and relevance of SKF’s product portfolio across diverse industrial applications.
   

  





 We are looking to identify suitable candidates for the role of Product Manager – Industrial Grease, dedicated to the ISEAM business. The role will be responsible for driving the profitable growth of the Industrial Grease portfolio in ISEAM through clear product strategy, portfolio development, localization, sourcing and go\-to\-market execution, in close alignment with regional and global teams.
   

  





**Key Purpose of the Job**




 To drive profitable growth of the Industrial Grease business in ISEAM by developing and executing product, portfolio, sourcing and go\-to\-market strategies aligned with ISEAM growth priorities, regional objectives and global product line direction.
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




 Develop and execute the Industrial Grease product line strategy for ISEAM, aligned with market opportunities, industry segment priorities, profitability objectives and overall, ISEAM growth strategy.
   

  





 Build and manage a clear product roadmap covering portfolio development, new product introductions, product enhancements, lifecycle management and end\-of\-life planning.
   

  





 Define and strengthen the Industrial Grease portfolio for ISEAM by identifying gaps, prioritizing offers, optimizing assortment and improving product line competitiveness across target segments and channels.
   

  





 Drive profitable business growth across relevant Industrial channels by working closely with sales, application engineering, supply chain and global product line teams to convert market opportunities into scalable offers.
   

  





 Lead localization and sourcing initiatives by identifying ISEAM\-specific requirements, supporting product testing and validation, developing local supply chain capability and improving cost competitiveness.
   

  





 Bring an outside\-in perspective by tracking customer needs, market trends, competitor dynamics and industry developments, and translating these insights into product strategy, value propositions and business cases.
   

  





 Collaborate with regional and global teams to align on strategic focus areas, leverage global capabilities and drive projects that support growth and competitiveness in ISEAM.
   

  





 Prepare and present business cases, portfolio reviews, performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management.
   

  





****Job Requirements****




 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business Administration; MBA or advanced degree will be an advantage.
   

  





 Minimum 8\+ years of experience across sales, application engineering, strategy or product management, with sales experience being mandatory.
   

  





 At least 5\+ years of experience in an industrial grease\-selling multinational organization in ISEAM.
   

  





 Strong understanding of Industrial Grease portfolios, applications, technical product aspects and customer requirements.
   

  





 Strong understanding of the ISEAMn Industrial Grease market, including competitive dynamics, customer segments and channel landscape.
   

  





 Proven track record in sales, business development, product strategy or portfolio management.
   

  





 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to build business cases and make commercially sound decisions.
   

  





 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to collect, interpret and visualize complex data to support strategy and decision\-making.
   

  





 Strategic thinker with an outside\-in mindset and the ability to translate market insights into practical growth actions.
   

  





 Strong collaboration, facilitation, influencing and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix and cross\-functional environment.
   

  





 Proactive, open\-minded team player with the ability to drive change, inspire others and influence stakeholders at different levels.
   

  





 Interested, please share your updated profile – prachi.chourasia@skf.com
   

  





****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Edwin AI
description:
**About Us:**
 We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.
   

  

**This position is located in Pune.** 
 You'll be working in a major tech center of Pune, India. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.
   

  

 To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our Careers Page.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
 LogicMonitor® is the AI\-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on\-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.
   

  

 Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!
   

  

 The Sr. Solutions Architect, Edwin AI supports the Professional Services (PS) organization as advisor across all regions and Edwin AI projects, directly supporting complex engagements and providing oversight on less complex ones. This role acts as global delivery expert responsible for defining, capturing, and sharing best practices, acting as the primary conduit between Professional Services and Edwin AI product teams. This Edwin AI architect is accountable for multiplying team expertise by mentoring regional teams and ensuring consistent high\-quality delivery across all geographies.
   

  

**Here's a closer look at this key role:**
* Regularly interacts with LogicMonitor existing customers to scope implementations, technically assess the feasibility and approach for customer monitoring and Edwin AI use cases and integrations, in close alignment with the Edwin Product team
* Act as Edwin AI delivery expert responsible for defining, capturing, and sharing best practices, acting as the primary conduit between Professional Services and Edwin AI product teams
* Define, develop, build and maintain best practices for Edwin AI deployments; share expertise by mentoring regional teams and partners as necessary
* Ensuring consistent high\-quality delivery of Edwin AI across all geographies
* Build and/or oversee accurate estimates for services proposals, including hours effort, timeframe and pricing with Sales, CS and customers to develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs) and design documentation
* Regularly perform post\-sales discovery and design of custom solutions with customers (requirements gathering, researching, prototyping and design documentation)
* Works collaboratively with the Project Management and Solutions Engineer teams to guide post\-sales services delivery, aligning project team to SOW deliverables, scope of engagement, and technical escalations (where necessary)
* Assist regional Solutions Engineers with deployment of tasks and solutions during PS engagements; focus on the most complex engagements with oversight on less complex engagements
* Regularly review Edwin AI and core LogicMonitor platform product updates and consult with other SAs on services approach for new features and enhancements
* Work closely with PS leadership to drive value in PS offerings and where required make adjustments to current packages to ensure both value to the customer at a price that is commensurate to the level of effort required to deliver the offering
* Work closely with Edwin AI product teams to evaluate product direction, raise product issues and provide customer feedback to help drive the product roadmap; participate in Customer advisory boards as needed


**What You'll Need:**
* Bachelor's Degree or higher in computer science or related field
* 8\+ years experience of working as an IT professional supporting one or more domains of IT infrastructure: server, network, security, storage, virtualization, cloud leveraging best practice processes such as ITIL; software development experience in commercial or enterprise applications

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end\-to\-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

The role brings deep operational expertise into solution development, helping translate business requirements, validate operational feasibility, identify execution risks, and continuously improve solutions through frontline insights and structured feedback. The role actively drives strategic initiatives that combine platform capabilities, process transformation, and scalable technology solutions to improve operational effectiveness, accelerate business transformation, and deliver sustainable business value. The role serves as a key bridge between business, Platform, xPOs and Tech, ensuring that global solutions remain practical, scalable, execution\-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Drive strategic initiatives that combine platform capabilities, process transformation, and scalable technology solutions to improve operational effectiveness and deliver sustainable business value.

* Drive the adoption and effective utilization of platform capabilities, AI, automation, and other technology\-enabled solutions to enhance operational performance and customer experience.
* Lead implementation planning and deployment readiness by identifying dependencies, risks, adoption requirements, and operational constraints to ensure successful solution rollout and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce operational complexity, and continuously improve business outcomes through structured feedback and data\-driven insights.
* Influence and align cross\-functional stakeholders by providing thought leadership, business expertise, and recommendations that support strategic decision\-making and transformation goals.

* Proven experience leading or driving cross\-functional transformation initiatives involving platform deployment, process redesign, business standardization, automation, or technology\-enabled operating model change.
* Experience working across global or regional organizations with diverse stakeholder groups, complex operating environments, and matrix\-based governance structures.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Conceptual \& Structural Thinking: Ability to abstract overarching patterns from complex operational environments and translate them into structured, scalable business solutions and operating models.
* End\-to\-End Process Mindset: Ability to evaluate solutions from an end\-to\-end perspective, balancing standardization, automation integrity, scalability, risk controls, and long\-term sustainability over short\-term fixes.
* Advanced Analytical Skills: Ability to leverage data, operational insights, and structured problem solving to identify root causes, assess solution effectiveness, and develop fact\-based recommendations.
* Transformation Planning \& Execution Readiness: Ability to develop design\-to\-deployment roadmaps, assess dependencies and adoption requirements, manage implementation risks, and ensure organizational readiness for change.
* Stakeholder Management \& Influencing: Ability to navigate complex matrix organizations, bridge Global Platform and Regional Operations perspectives, and drive alignment across stakeholders without direct authority.

* Knowledge of analytical and problem\-solving methodologies, including root cause analysis, process diagnostics, and business performance evaluation.
* Understanding of business transformation, change management, implementation governance, and organizational adoption principles.
* Knowledge of platform\-enabled operating models and the interaction between business processes, technology capabilities, governance structures, and execution requirements.
* Working knowledge of AI, automation, workflow solutions, and digital technologies, with the ability to evaluate how technology can be effectively combined with process design to deliver business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of customer experience, supply chain, logistics, or other operationally intensive business environments.


**Key measures/success criteria**
